# Fear-Glee Index Site is Live

I've posted before about my idea for a "fear glee" index for AI, and I just whipped up a quick MVP of the index here based on people just recording their current sentiment (you can add a record every 24h). Could you take a minute to vote right now? Anonymous, and asks a couple of basic demographic questions to help weight the responses in interesting ways. [Fear-Glee Index Site](https://fearglee.protocolized.io/)
